name: Troefcall
description: Troefcall is a 4-player partnership trick-taking game from Suriname, also popular in the Netherlands. The 'trump caller' gets 5 cards first and declares trump. Teams try to win 7+ tricks. Winning first 7 in a row = 'Kap Partij' (5 pts). All 13 = 'Baunie' (15 pts). If Baunie attempted but failed, opponents score 2.

content.text: Troefcall is a 4-player partnership trick-taking game from Suriname, also popular in the Netherlands. The 'trump caller' gets 5 cards first and declares trump. Teams try to win 7+ tricks. Winning first 7 in a row = 'Kap Partij' (5 pts). All 13 = 'Baunie' (15 pts). If Baunie attempted but failed, opponents score 2.

Troefcall is a trick-taking game for four players played in the former Dutch colony Suriname and in the Surinamese community in the Netherlands. It has similarity to the Indian game Court Piece (Rang), possibly due to the presence of a significant minority of ethnic Indians in Suriname. The name (troefcall = 'trump call') mixes Dutch and English; the game was introduced to the Netherlands via Surinamese Dutch and is played across Surinamese population groups. Federations (TSBN in the Netherlands, STcB in Suriname) organize competitions.
Trump caller gets 5 first, declares trump. Then 5+4+4 to each.
